outcome: no side effects of antenatal steroids
no requirement for postnatal BPS surgery
cohort: A 21-year-old woman pregnant with monochorionic twins, one of whom was affected by severe bronchopulmonary sequestration (BPS) and fetal hydrops.
finding: Repeated courses of antenatal betamethasone treatment in a monochorionic twin with severe bronchopulmonary sequestration (BPS) and fetal hydrops resulted in recovery from hydrops and reduction in BPS parameters.
